sources.title: CycloneDX Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: OpenSSF Scorecard：風險訊號與發布決策
related.titleEn: OpenSSF Scorecard: risk signals and release decisions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付20份狀態表、版本化理由、到期排程及重新開啟案件的紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twenty dispositions, versioned justifications, expiry schedule and records of reopened cases.
related.difference: 將各檢查的證據、失敗原因與風險分開，辨識未執行或不適用項，拒絕只看平均分數。
related.differenceEn: Separate evidence, failure reason and risk for each check; identify skipped and non-applicable items rather than relying on an average.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 待處理=受影響+調查中+過期聲明；完成狀態與證據新鮮度是不同維度。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 20份合成聲明：8份有證據而不受影響、5份受影響、4份已修復、3份調查中。 初始待處理5+3=8份，占40%。
本課自訂加權平均=Σ權重×分數/Σ權重；這不是官方總分演算法，也不是漏洞機率。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 四項教學分數8、6、10、2；權重1、2、1、4，最後一項代表重要發布控制。 加權分數=(8+12+10+8)/8=4.75，簡單平均為6.5。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Actionable items include affected, under-investigation and expired claims; disposition and freshness are separate dimensions. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twenty synthetic claims comprise eight evidenced not-affected, five affected, four fixed and three under investigation. Initially 5+3=8 claims require action, or 40%.

The teaching weighted mean is Σweight×score/Σweight; it is neither the official aggregate algorithm nor a vulnerability probability. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Four teaching scores are 8,6,10,2 with weights 1,2,1,4; the last represents a critical release control. Weighted score=(8+12+10+8)/8=4.75, versus a simple mean of 6.5.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Trivy：映像掃描與修復可用性分流
related.titleEn: Trivy: image findings and fix-availability triage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付20份狀態表、版本化理由、到期排程及重新開啟案件的紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twenty dispositions, versioned justifications, expiry schedule and records of reopened cases.
related.difference: 把映像摘要、資料庫時間、套件版本、公告識別及修復狀態連在一起，避免使用漂移標籤。
related.differenceEn: Link image digest, database timestamp, package version, advisory and fix status, avoiding mutable image tags.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 待處理=受影響+調查中+過期聲明；完成狀態與證據新鮮度是不同維度。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 20份合成聲明：8份有證據而不受影響、5份受影響、4份已修復、3份調查中。 初始待處理5+3=8份，占40%。
可立即修復比例=有可用相容修復的唯一發現/需處理發現；不代表修復後零風險。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 報告有30筆去重後需處理發現，18筆有修復版本，12筆暫無；其中6筆修復仍需相容性驗證。 有版本可修復比例18/30=60%；已確認可採用的修復只有12/30=40%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Actionable items include affected, under-investigation and expired claims; disposition and freshness are separate dimensions. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twenty synthetic claims comprise eight evidenced not-affected, five affected, four fixed and three under investigation. Initially 5+3=8 claims require action, or 40%.

Immediately fixable fraction counts unique actionable findings with compatible fixes; it does not imply zero residual risk. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Thirty unique actionable findings include eighteen with fixes and twelve without; six available fixes still need compatibility validation. Fix availability is 60%, but confirmed adoptable fixes are only 12/30=40%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
